title: BlackboardAnalysis.v1
description: An ANALYSIS entry: a claim a worker derived by reasoning over earlier entries. supporting_entry_ids[] preserves the lineage from the claim to the observations/calculations it rests on (a conclusion always points back to its support). serves_truth is pinned const false — an analysis is the swarm's reasoning, NEVER served truth; only Baltor's separate governance layer (GovernedBlackboardEntry + verification) may make anything derived from it promotable.

entry_id.description: id of the BlackboardEntry (kind=analysis) this body belongs to

blackboard_id.description: the blackboard this analysis belongs to

supporting_entry_ids.description: entry_ids of the observations/calculations/sources this claim rests on (lineage from conclusion to support)

serves_truth.description: ALWAYS false — an analysis is swarm reasoning, never served truth; promotion is a separate Baltor-governed decision
